audit.why: Akshan owning levels 1-3 and losing the post-item duel matches the kit: Yi has no ranged tool and Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1, so he cannot punish poke until he has attack speed.
audit.corrected: Difficulty read stands; only the timing anchors were missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes give no cooldowns at all — the packet flagged the whole matchup for missing sequencing.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s and shortens with every basic attack he lands; Highlander is a flat 85s and makes him immune to slows. Those two numbers are the whole step-up decision.
audit.corrected: Poke on Alpha Strike's downtime (20s at rank 1, shortened by his autos); respect Highlander's flat 85s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike's untargetability and Meditate's sustain never reach the page.
audit.why: Yi is untargetable for the whole Alpha Strike, so a Comeuppance fired as he commits is simply lost; Meditate (10s) restores health and reduces damage taken, which is why chip poke does not stick without Grievous Wounds. Highlander's slow immunity also means kiting through slows fails.
audit.corrected: Never fire R into Alpha Strike — he is untargetable through it; buy Grievous Wounds for Meditate; slows don't hold him under Highlander.

edits.before: Both ultimates spike at once — an even skill fight as long as you keep your range.
edits.after: Both ults spike at once — Highlander (85s) is slow-immune, so range is your answer.

edits.before: His DPS spike: Wuju true damage out-DPSes you the moment he sticks. Swing out early, every time.
edits.after: His DPS spike: Wuju Style's true damage out-DPSes you the moment he sticks. Swing out before he closes.

edits.before: By 4 his Wuju Style points bring it to even — trades are honest now, so pick them around your shield.
edits.after: By 4 his Wuju Style points bring it to even — trades are honest now, so pick them on Alpha Strike's 20s down.

edits.before: Level 6 stays a skill stage: both ultimates spike at once and the fight goes to whoever uses theirs better.
edits.after: Level 6 is a skill stage: Highlander (85s) makes him slow-immune, so the fight goes to whoever spends it better.

edits.before: Free poke phase — take it. Your double-hit Q chips him every time he shows, your passive shield wins the level 2 exchanges, and level 3's full kite pattern means he can't punish a thing you do. Deny farm, stack plates, and remember the lead you build now pays the bill later.
edits.after: Free poke phase — take it. Your double-hit Q chips him every time he shows, your passive shield wins the level 2 exchanges, and level 3's kite pattern means he can't punish you. Poke the moment Alpha Strike (20s at rank 1) is spent — his basic attacks shorten it, so count his autos, not seconds.

edits.before: By 4 his Wuju points even the trades and 6 puts both ults on the table — a fair skill fight as long as you keep your range. The moment his first item finishes, stop taking honest fights: if he sticks, his true damage out-DPSes you. Swing out early, save Comeuppance for his commit, and don't greed waves.
edits.after: By 4 his Wuju points even the trades and 6 puts both ults on the table. He is untargetable through Alpha Strike, so a Comeuppance fired as he commits is lost — bait the dash, then channel. The moment his first item finishes, stop taking honest fights: Meditate heals your chip back, so buy Grievous Wounds and swing out early.

edits.before: Late is his in any stuck fight — Highlander resets and true damage shred a squishy marksman. Never let him start the fight: poke him entering lanes, swing over walls the moment he flashes intent, and in teamfights stand behind your frontline and let Comeuppance and revives do the heavy lifting.
edits.after: Late is his in any stuck fight — Highlander refunds his cooldowns on takedowns and its slow immunity means kiting items don't hold him. Never let him start the fight: poke him entering lanes, swing over walls the moment he flashes intent, and in teamfights stand behind your frontline and let Comeuppance and revives work.

notes: Packet flagged zero cooldown sequencing here; Alpha Strike (20s, shortened by autos), Meditate (10s) and Highlander (85s) now anchor the advice. Alpha Strike's untargetability versus a fired Comeuppance was absent everywhere.
